_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §4 (004 task T014), for curation/option-overrides.json. Keyed (datasheet_id, line): a full group-plus-choices structure for an option row the grammar left unparsed. THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO POINTS FIELD ANYWHERE IN THIS SCHEMA. Cost comes from the points source and only from there (C8/R3, 004 FR-013), so a curator may supply the structure that was missed but never a number the publisher did not publish -- and a schema with nowhere to put a price is a stronger control than a review rule saying not to. Likewise there is no description field: a choice is a name plus mechanical values, which is what stops this class becoming a prose channel (FR-016).
title: curation/option-overrides.json

scope_n.description: Present exactly when scope is per_n_models.

eligible_model_name.description: 006 FR-004. The model name the stem restricts the option to. A NAME, never prose, and never a fourth member of `scope` -- adding one to that closed enum would break a consumer that validates it. Independent of eligible_max_count: a stem may name a subset without a cap.

eligible_max_count.description: 006 FR-004. The maximum number of that model the stem makes eligible. Carried as the source states it and NOT reconciled against the named model's own composition band (spec Clarifications, 2026-08-09).

is_per_model.description: 006 FR-004. True when the source distributes the option per eligible model rather than once across the unit. Omitted when the source does not distinguish -- never defaulted, because defaulting it to false would over-grant on the majority form of the residual.

is_no_change.description: An explicit 'no change' alternative. It never carries a price, because publishing one would present 'take nothing' as a purchasable item.

items.description: 006 FR-005..FR-007. The replaced set and the granted bundle, in the source's own order. Optional: a 004-shaped override that states grants_weapon_line and no items is expanded by the assembler into the single-element list guarantee 12 requires, and a curator's stated weapon_line is USED, never re-derived.

note.description: A curator's sentence about MECHANICS OR PROCESS. It must not quote source text.
